title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Event group chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap, tenant notice and Android release notes support the feature, rollout and Teams Rooms Pro requirement. The meeting-policy path and PowerShell command are documented, and the briefing accurately distinguishes presenter chat from the government-cloud attendee-chat restriction.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap and notice describe a chat tab, not an agent or automated action.
claims.quote: people in the room will have access to the private chat for presenters that appears as a separate chat tab on the meeting chat pane ... Users in the room can also switch to a separate chat that is shared by both presenters and attendees.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is a general policy controlling whether meeting participants can read and send chat.
claims.quote: The **Meeting chat** setting controls whether participants in your users' meetings can read and send chat messages.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to **Meetings** > **Meeting policies**. ... Select the policy you want to edit. ... Go to the **Meeting engagement** section. ... Set **Meeting chat** to your chosen value

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell supports Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled to disable meeting chat.
claims.quote: in order to set the value of MeetingChatEnabledType to Disabled, you will need to also set the value of LobbyChat to disabled. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled
